name: Seitenshi Yumiel Shadow Crusade
original_name: 聖天使ユミエル シャドークルセイド
source:
Eclipse.... It's a tragic fate of human beings who ruined themselves with their desire. There is also a girl who hunts them. Her name is Yumiel. Her mother was killed by Eclipse when she was a child. Since then, she has been fighting Eclipse. One day, she meets Eriko and becomes friends with her. But her peaceful life ends soon.... Days later, she falls into a trap set by Eclipse and get captured by them....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090810160828/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012892]ErogeShop[/url]]
